name: Learning & Knowledge
description: Articles, tutorials, courses, explainers, research, papers, study material, and knowledge saved to understand later.

tree.name: Learning
tree.description: Knowledge material, articles, tutorials, courses, research, study notes, and explainers.

profile.summary: Use when the main reason to save the material is to learn, understand, study, or reference knowledge later. Prefer Software for implementation-heavy developer material and AI for AI-specific tool or model material.
negative_examples: Utility saved only to use, not to learn.

children.name: Articles & Reading
children.description: Articles, blog posts, essays, saved links, long reads, and reading-list material.

profile.summary: Use for articles and reading-list items: blog posts, essays, Habr links, long reads, explainers, and saved references intended for reading.
negative_examples: Tool directory saved for direct use.

children.name: Tutorials & Courses
children.description: How-to guides, courses, lessons, exercises, beginner material, and step-by-step learning.

profile.summary: Use for guided learning: tutorials, courses, lessons, exercises, beginner guides, step-by-step instructions, and skill-building material.
positive_examples: How-to write better prompts over a week.
negative_examples: App roundup with no learning path.

children.name: Research & Papers
children.description: Academic papers, research notes, scientific material, datasets, experiments, and evidence.

profile.summary: Use for research-oriented material: papers, scientific claims, datasets, experiments, research notes, citations, methods, and evidence-based investigation.
negative_examples: AI tool announcement with no research detail.

children.name: Explainers
children.description: Concept explanations, comparisons, summaries, pros and cons, context notes, and decision background.

profile.summary: Use for material that explains a concept or compares options: summaries, pros and cons, context notes, background explanations, and decision-support knowledge.
negative_examples: Specific app saved only to install.
